# UbuntuApps

> Independent guides to the best apps for Ubuntu, installing software with apt, snap, Flatpak, .deb, and AppImage, and choosing an Ubuntu LTS release.

## Pages

- [Home](https://ubuntuapps.com/): Overview of UbuntuApps guides and quick answers about installing software on Ubuntu.
- [The best apps for Ubuntu, by category](https://ubuntuapps.com/best-ubuntu-apps.html): Recommended Ubuntu apps for browsing, office, media, creative work, development, notes, and gaming.
- [How to install apps on Ubuntu: apt vs snap vs Flatpak vs .deb vs AppImage](https://ubuntuapps.com/install-apps-ubuntu-apt-snap-flatpak.html): Compare Ubuntu packaging formats with commands for apt, snap, Flatpak, .deb files, and AppImage.
- [Things to do after installing Ubuntu: a practical checklist](https://ubuntuapps.com/things-to-install-after-ubuntu.html): Post-install checklist: updates, drivers, codecs, backups, firewall, Flatpak, and essential apps.
- [Ubuntu alternatives to Windows and Mac apps](https://ubuntuapps.com/ubuntu-alternatives-windows-mac-apps.html): Linux replacements for common Windows and macOS apps, plus Wine, Bottles, Proton, and VMs.
- [Ubuntu LTS releases explained: support timelines and upgrades](https://ubuntuapps.com/ubuntu-lts-releases.html): Ubuntu LTS vs interim releases, support timelines, Ubuntu Pro ESM, and safe upgrade steps.
- [About UbuntuApps](https://ubuntuapps.com/about.html): What UbuntuApps is, how guides are written, and our independence from Canonical.
- [Contact UbuntuApps](https://ubuntuapps.com/contact.html): How to reach the UbuntuApps team by email.
- [Privacy Policy](https://ubuntuapps.com/privacy.html): How UbuntuApps handles visitor data: minimal collection, no selling of data.
